parameters.jsCode:
const j = $input.item.json;
const desc = (j.description || '').slice(0, 6000);

const prompt = 'You are filtering remote jobs for Jerry, who lives in Taiwan.\n\n' +
  'The most important rule:\n' +
  'Jerry must be able to work this job while physically based in Taiwan.\n\n' +
  'Do not pass the job only because it says remote.\n\n' +
  'Reject the job if it requires the worker to live in the US, Canada, UK, EU, Europe, Australia, or any specific country outside Taiwan.\n' +
  'Reject the job if it requires local work authorization outside Taiwan.\n' +
  'Reject the job if it is hybrid, onsite, or remote within one country only.\n' +
  'Reject the job if it requires fixed working hours that would force Jerry to work through the night in Taiwan.\n\n' +
  'Keep the job only if one of these is true:\n' +
  '- The job says worldwide remote.\n' +
  '- The job says work from anywhere.\n' +
  '- The job says global remote.\n' +
  '- The job says APAC remote.\n' +
  '- The job allows international contractors.\n' +
  '- The job accepts people based anywhere.\n' +
  '- The company hires through EOR, Deel, Remote.com, Oyster, or contractor agreement.\n\n' +
  'Return JSON only with exactly these fields: taiwan_eligible (yes, no, or unclear), reason (a short reason), location_risk (low, medium, or high), timezone_risk (low, medium, or high), contractor_possible (yes, no, or unclear), decision (keep, reject, or manual_check).\n\n' +
  'Job post:\n' + desc;

j.ai_request_body = JSON.stringify({
  model: 'claude-sonnet-5',
  max_tokens: 400,
  temperature: 0,
  messages: [{ role: 'user', content: prompt }]
});

return { json: j };

const j = $input.item.json;

const prompt = 'Write a short cover letter for Jerry.\n\n' +
  'Jerry is based in Taiwan and wants async global remote work.\n\n' +
  'Use this background:\n' +
  '- Bilingual English and Mandarin\n' +
  '- Grew up in California and Taiwan\n' +
  '- Digital marketing background\n' +
  '- Data science bootcamp experience\n' +
  '- Python, SQL, Tableau, Power BI\n' +
  '- Performance marketing, SEO, PPC, GA4, Meta Ads, Google Ads\n' +
  '- AI tools: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor\n' +
  '- Experience with dashboards, EDA, machine learning projects, customer segmentation, fraud detection, and marketing analytics\n\n' +
  'Make the letter specific to this job.\n\n' +
  'Job title: ' + (j.job_title || '') + '\n' +
  'Company: ' + (j.company || '') + '\n' +
  'Job description: ' + (j.description || '').slice(0, 3000) + '\n\n' +
  'Mention how Jerry can help the company:\n' +
  '- reduce manual analysis time\n' +
  '- improve reporting speed\n' +
  '- connect marketing and data\n' +
  '- build AI-assisted workflows\n' +
  '- turn messy data into business action\n\n' +
  'Keep it under 220 words.\n\n' +
  'Tone: confident, direct, human, not desperate.';

j.cover_letter_request_body = JSON.stringify({
  model: 'claude-sonnet-5',
  max_tokens: 500,
  temperature: 0.4,
  messages: [{ role: 'user', content: prompt }]
});

return { json: j };

parameters.subject: Daily Taiwan Eligible Async Remote Jobs

parameters.content:
## Wellfound / Dynamite Jobs / YC Work at a Startup / Otta

These four boards have no public API or RSS feed and are heavily JS-rendered with anti-bot protection, so a plain HTTP Request node cannot reliably pull jobs from them (and scraping may violate their Terms of Service).

The 4 HTTP Request nodes on the left are disabled placeholders only - they are **not** wired into the pipeline.

Recommended options instead:
1. Subscribe to each site's email job-alert digest, forward matching emails to a Gmail label, and add a Gmail-trigger branch that reads + normalizes those emails into the same schema used below.
2. Use a dedicated scraping service (e.g. Apify, Bright Data, ScrapingBee) in a separate workflow that POSTs normalized jobs to a Webhook node feeding the same Normalize step.
3. Check periodically by hand - these boards tend to have fewer worldwide-remote/contractor-friendly listings anyway.

## Before you activate this workflow

1. Create a Google Sheet named 'Taiwan Eligible Async Remote Jobs' with 4 tabs: Raw Jobs, Filtered Jobs, Applied, Rejected (headers per the README). Paste its ID into every Google Sheets node (documentId).
2. Add credentials: Google Sheets OAuth2, an HTTP Header Auth credential named 'x-api-key' holding your Anthropic API key (used by both Claude HTTP Request nodes), Telegram Bot API, Gmail OAuth2.
3. Fill in your Telegram chat ID and/or email address on the alert + digest nodes.
4. Workflow timezone is set to Asia/Taipei in workflow Settings so the 08:30 cron fires at 08:30 Taiwan time.
5. This workflow never auto-submits an application - 'apply' only sets application_status to 'Ready to Apply' in the Filtered Jobs sheet plus a draft cover letter. You still review and send it yourself.
6. The 'Applied' sheet is intentionally not written by this workflow - update it yourself (or build a small companion workflow) when you actually apply, since submitting applications should stay a human decision.
